scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p fixtures && biome check . && vitest run && pnpm check:bundle
scripts.check:bundle: pnpm --filter @kalamo/web build && ls apps/web/dist/assets/*.js > /dev/null && ! grep -l xmldom apps/web/dist/assets/*.js && ! grep -l PathKit apps/web/dist/assets/index-*.js && ls apps/web/dist/assets/pathkit-*.wasm > /dev/null && ! grep -l WebPDecode apps/web/dist/assets/*
scripts.bench: pnpm --filter @kalamo/web build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c apps/edge/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/bench && node fixtures/agent-benchmarks/run.ts
scripts.roundtrip: pnpm --filter @kalamo/web build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c apps/edge/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/roundtrip && node fixtures/roundtrip.ts
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @kalamo/web build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c apps/edge/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev -c apps/edge/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter @kalamo/web build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c apps/edge/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c apps/edge/wrangler.jsonc --secrets-file apps/edge/.deploy.vars
